title: 12 executives who left OpenAI in 2026
excerpt: OpenAI continues to experience significant executive turnover in 2026, with key figures like Brad Lightcap and Fidji Simo stepping down.
content_html:

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

OpenAI's revolving door is still spinning.

The ChatGPT maker has lost a string of senior leaders in 2026, including former operating chief Brad Lightcap, applications CEO Fidji Simo, chief revenue officer Denise Dresser, and executives overseeing marketing, enterprise products, science, safety, and ethics. Some left to start new ventures, while some stepped back for health reasons.

The departures follow another year of turnover in 2025, when OpenAI lost its chief people and communications officers, a top researcher who went on to launch an AI-science startup, and at least seven researchers recruited by Meta.

Here are the prominent OpenAI leaders who have headed for the exits in 2026.

Denise Dresser

OpenAI announced in August that its chief revenue officer, Denise Dresser, is leaving the company. Dresser began the position in December 2025.

"Denise will leave OpenAI to pursue other opportunities following a transition period, during which she will work closely with the business team to support our customers," the company wrote in a blog post.

Dali Rajic will take over the role.

Brad Lightcap

Brad Lightcap, who worked at OpenAI since 2018, announced his departure on X in August. Lightcap told his followers that he's leaving the startup "to start something new."

"Over the last few months, I've been focused on the next horizon and what would stand in the way of mission success. I believe there are a few important new things the world will need to get right as we enter this next period," Lightcap said on X. "I'll have more to share soon, but I believe in OpenAI more than ever and am excited to help you all advance the mission from a different vantage point."

Lightcap began his tenure at OpenAI as chief financial officer before transitioning to chief operating officer in 2022. In April, OpenAI said Lightcap moved to a role focused on special projects.

Fidji Simo

In July, Fidji Simo announced she would step down from her role as OpenAI's CEO of applications and transition to a part-time advisor role. Simo, who was diagnosed with postural tachycardia syndrome, or POTS, in 2019, initially took medical leave in April.

"Over the last seven years, I've spent countless hours in doctors' offices, dealing with symptoms, treatments, insurance, uncertainty, and all the invisible work that comes with being a patient," Simo wrote on X in July. "Like millions of others living with chronic illness, I've experienced firsthand how difficult healthcare can be to navigate, even when you have every possible advantage."

Simo became the CEO of applications in May 2025.

Kevin Weil

Kevin Weil announced his departure on X in April.

"It's been a mind-expanding two years, from Chief Product Officer to joining the research team and starting OpenAI for Science," he said.

Weil first joined OpenAI in 2024 as its chief product officer. He later served as vice president of OpenAI for Science, an initiative to build an AI-powered platform to accelerate scientific discovery, starting in October 2025.

Currently, Weil heads an AI science startup that sought a valuation of at least $750 million.

Bill Peebles

Bill Peebles worked as a research scientist at OpenAI for three years before leaving the company in April 2026. Peebles served as the head of Sora, an AI model that uses text prompts to create videos.

"While the original Sora ignited a huge amount of investment in video across the industry, it took the next generation of models with Sora 2 for the broader public to understand the transformation happening," Peeble said on X. "I'm proud of all the sleepless nights before and after the launch this team endured in order to deploy the technology in a responsible way and help steer societal norms."

The video generation AI model first became available to users in December 2024. Nine months later, OpenAI released an updated model — Sora 2 — and an app meant to rival social media sites.

Although the app drummed up major hype, its momentum quickly faded.

OpenAI shut down Sora and its app this April.

Srinivas Narayanan

Srinivas Narayanan, OpenAI's chief technology officer for business applications, announced in April that he was leaving after three years.

"Leading the b2b engineering team has been an enormous privilege," Narayanan wrote on LinkedIn. "With the recent/upcoming product launches, this felt like the right time to step back."

Narayanan said he planned to spend time with his parents in India before deciding what to do next. He joined OpenAI as vice president of engineering and led teams working on ChatGPT and the company's enterprise products.

Kate Rouch

Kate Rouch stepped down as OpenAI's chief marketing officer in April to focus on her recovery from breast cancer.

Rouch joined OpenAI in December 2024 after more than a decade at Meta, where she served as global head of brand and product marketing. She took medical leave in 2025 while undergoing treatment, then returned to OpenAI.

OpenAI previously said Rouch could eventually return in a more narrowly defined position when her health allowed, and that the company was searching for a new chief marketing officer.

Barret Zoph

Barret Zoph left OpenAI in June, about five months after returning to lead its enterprise AI sales efforts.

Zoph initially departed OpenAI in September 2024 and cofounded Thinking Machines Lab with former OpenAI chief technology officer Mira Murati. He returned to OpenAI in January 2026 after leaving the rival startup.

OpenAI did not disclose why Zoph left.

Chloé Bakalar

Chloé Bakalar, OpenAI's head of ethics, left the company in July, less than a year after joining.

Bakalar joined OpenAI in August 2025 after spending about six years working on responsible AI at Meta. At OpenAI, she examined questions surrounding model behavior, human relationships with AI, and whether advanced systems could warrant moral consideration.

Johannes Heidecke

Johannes Heidecke, who led OpenAI's safety systems team, left the company in July amid a reorganization of its safety operations.

Heidecke joined OpenAI in 2021 and took charge of safety systems in 2024. His team evaluated models for potentially dangerous capabilities and developed safeguards intended to prevent harmful behavior.

Following his departure, OpenAI placed its safety teams under Mia Glaese, its vice president of research and safety.

Joshua Achiam

Joshua Achiam, OpenAI's chief futurist, left the company in July after nearly nine years.

Achiam previously led OpenAI's mission alignment team, which was tasked with helping the company uphold its founding goal of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits humanity. OpenAI disbanded that team in early 2026 and moved Achiam into the chief futurist role.

Caitlin Kalinowski

Caitlin Kalinowski, who led OpenAI's robotics and consumer hardware team, resigned in March over concerns about the company's agreement with the Pentagon.

"Surveillance of Americans without judicial oversight and lethal autonomy without human authorization are lines that deserved more deliberation than they got," Kalinowski wrote on LinkedIn. She later said her objection was primarily about governance and that the agreement had been announced before its safeguards were fully defined.

Kalinowski joined OpenAI in November 2024 after leading Meta's augmented-reality hardware efforts, including its Orion glasses project. OpenAI said its Pentagon agreement prohibited domestic surveillance and the use of autonomous weapons.

blocks.html_en: Weil first joined OpenAI in 2024 as its chief product officer. He later served as vice president of OpenAI for Science, an initiative to build an AI-powered platform to accelerate scientific discovery, starting in October 2025.

sentences.en: Weil first joined OpenAI in 2024 as its chief product officer.
sentences.zh: Weil 于 2024 年首次加入 OpenAI，担任首席产品官。

sentences.en: He later served as vice president of OpenAI for Science, an initiative to build an AI-powered platform to accelerate scientific discovery, starting in October 2025.
sentences.zh: 随后，他从 2025 年 10 月开始担任 OpenAI for Science 的副总裁，该计划旨在构建人工智能驱动的平台以加速科学发现。

blocks.html_en: Currently, Weil heads an AI science startup that sought a valuation of at least $750 million.

sentences.en: Currently, Weil heads an AI science startup that sought a valuation of at least $750 million.
sentences.zh: 目前，Weil 领导着一家人工智能科学初创公司，寻求至少 7.5 亿美元的估值。

blocks.html_en: Bill Peebles

sentences.en: Bill Peebles
sentences.zh: 比尔·皮布尔斯

blocks.html_en: Bill Peebles worked as a research scientist at OpenAI for three years before leaving the company in April 2026. Peebles served as the head of Sora, an AI model that uses text prompts to create videos.

sentences.en: Bill Peebles worked as a research scientist at OpenAI for three years before leaving the company in April 2026.
sentences.zh: Bill Peebles 在 OpenAI 担任了三年研究科学家，然后于 2026 年 4 月离开公司。

sentences.en: Peebles served as the head of Sora, an AI model that uses text prompts to create videos.
sentences.zh: Peebles 担任 Sora 的负责人，Sora 是一种使用文本提示创建视频的人工智能模型。

blocks.html_en: "While the original Sora ignited a huge amount of investment in video across the industry, it took the next generation of models with Sora 2 for the broader public to understand the transformation happening," Peeble said on X. "I'm proud of all the sleepless nights before and after the launch this team endured in order to deploy the technology in a responsible way and help steer societal norms."

sentences.en: "While the original Sora ignited a huge amount of investment in video across the industry, it took the next generation of models with Sora 2 for the broader public to understand the transformation happening," Peeble said on X.
sentences.zh: Peeble 在 X 上表示：“虽然最初的 Sora 引发了整个行业对视频的巨额投资，但只有下一代型号的 Sora 2 才能让更广泛的公众了解正在发生的转变。”

sentences.en: "I'm proud of all the sleepless nights before and after the launch this team endured in order to deploy the technology in a responsible way and help steer societal norms."
sentences.zh: “我为这个团队在发布前后经历的所有不眠之夜感到自豪，以便以负责任的方式部署该技术并帮助引导社会规范。”

blocks.html_en: The video generation AI model first became available to users in December 2024. Nine months later, OpenAI released an updated model — Sora 2 — and an app meant to rival social media sites.

sentences.en: The video generation AI model first became available to users in December 2024.
sentences.zh: 视频生成 AI 模型于 2024 年 12 月首次向用户提供。

sentences.en: Nine months later, OpenAI released an updated model — Sora 2 — and an app meant to rival social media sites.
sentences.zh: 九个月后，OpenAI 发布了更新的模型——Sora 2——以及一款旨在与社交媒体网站竞争的应用程序。

blocks.html_en: Although the app drummed up major hype, its momentum quickly faded.

sentences.en: Although the app drummed up major hype, its momentum quickly faded.
sentences.zh: 尽管该应用程序大肆宣传，但其势头很快就消退了。

blocks.html_en: OpenAI shut down Sora and its app this April.

sentences.en: OpenAI shut down Sora and its app this April.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 今年四月关闭了 Sora 及其应用程序。

blocks.html_en: Srinivas Narayanan

sentences.en: Srinivas Narayanan
sentences.zh: 斯里尼瓦斯·纳拉亚南

blocks.html_en: Srinivas Narayanan, OpenAI's chief technology officer for business applications, announced in April that he was leaving after three years.

sentences.en: Srinivas Narayanan, OpenAI's chief technology officer for business applications, announced in April that he was leaving after three years.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 商业应用首席技术官斯里尼瓦斯·纳拉亚南 (Srinivas Narayanan) 在 4 月份宣布，他在任职三年后将离职。

blocks.html_en: "Leading the b2b engineering team has been an enormous privilege," Narayanan wrote on LinkedIn. "With the recent/upcoming product launches, this felt like the right time to step back."

sentences.en: "Leading the b2b engineering team has been an enormous privilege," Narayanan wrote on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: “领导 B2B 工程团队是一种巨大的荣幸，”纳拉亚南在 LinkedIn 上写道。

sentences.en: "With the recent/upcoming product launches, this felt like the right time to step back."
sentences.zh: “随着最近/即将推出的产品，现在是退后一步的最佳时机。”

blocks.html_en: Narayanan said he planned to spend time with his parents in India before deciding what to do next. He joined OpenAI as vice president of engineering and led teams working on ChatGPT and the company's enterprise products.

sentences.en: Narayanan said he planned to spend time with his parents in India before deciding what to do next.
sentences.zh: 纳拉亚南说，他计划先去印度与父母共度时光，然后再决定下一步做什么。

sentences.en: He joined OpenAI as vice president of engineering and led teams working on ChatGPT and the company's enterprise products.
sentences.zh: 他加入 OpenAI 担任工程副总裁，领导 ChatGPT 和公司企业产品的团队工作。

blocks.html_en: Kate Rouch

sentences.en: Kate Rouch
sentences.zh: 凯特·鲁什

blocks.html_en: Kate Rouch stepped down as OpenAI's chief marketing officer in April to focus on her recovery from breast cancer.

sentences.en: Kate Rouch stepped down as OpenAI's chief marketing officer in April to focus on her recovery from breast cancer.
sentences.zh: Kate Rouch 于 4 月份辞去了 OpenAI 首席营销官的职务，专注于乳腺癌的康复。

blocks.html_en: Rouch joined OpenAI in December 2024 after more than a decade at Meta, where she served as global head of brand and product marketing. She took medical leave in 2025 while undergoing treatment, then returned to OpenAI.

sentences.en: Rouch joined OpenAI in December 2024 after more than a decade at Meta, where she served as global head of brand and product marketing.
sentences.zh: Rouch 于 2024 年 12 月加入 OpenAI，此前她在 Meta 工作了十多年，担任全球品牌和产品营销主管。

sentences.en: She took medical leave in 2025 while undergoing treatment, then returned to OpenAI.
sentences.zh: 2025年，她在接受治疗期间请了病假，然后回到了OpenAI。

blocks.html_en: OpenAI previously said Rouch could eventually return in a more narrowly defined position when her health allowed, and that the company was searching for a new chief marketing officer.

sentences.en: OpenAI previously said Rouch could eventually return in a more narrowly defined position when her health allowed, and that the company was searching for a new chief marketing officer.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 此前表示，如果鲁什的健康状况允许，她最终可能会返回一个更狭窄的职位，并且该公司正在寻找新的首席营销官。

blocks.html_en: Barret Zoph

sentences.en: Barret Zoph
sentences.zh: 巴雷特·佐夫

blocks.html_en: Barret Zoph left OpenAI in June, about five months after returning to lead its enterprise AI sales efforts.

sentences.en: Barret Zoph left OpenAI in June, about five months after returning to lead its enterprise AI sales efforts.
sentences.zh: Barret Zoph 于 6 月离开 OpenAI，大约五个月后，他返回领导其企业人工智能销售工作。

blocks.html_en: Zoph initially departed OpenAI in September 2024 and cofounded Thinking Machines Lab with former OpenAI chief technology officer Mira Murati. He returned to OpenAI in January 2026 after leaving the rival startup.

sentences.en: Zoph initially departed OpenAI in September 2024 and cofounded Thinking Machines Lab with former OpenAI chief technology officer Mira Murati.
sentences.zh: Zoph 最初于 2024 年 9 月离开 OpenAI，并与 OpenAI 前首席技术官 Mira Murati 共同创立了 Thinking Machines Lab。

sentences.en: He returned to OpenAI in January 2026 after leaving the rival startup.
sentences.zh: 在离开竞争对手初创公司 OpenAI 后，他于 2026 年 1 月重返 OpenAI。

blocks.html_en: OpenAI did not disclose why Zoph left.

sentences.en: OpenAI did not disclose why Zoph left.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 没有透露 Zoph 离开的原因。

blocks.html_en: Chloé Bakalar

sentences.en: Chloé Bakalar
sentences.zh: 克洛伊·巴卡拉

blocks.html_en: Chloé Bakalar, OpenAI's head of ethics, left the company in July, less than a year after joining.

sentences.en: Chloé Bakalar, OpenAI's head of ethics, left the company in July, less than a year after joining.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 道德主管 Chloé Bakalar 在加入公司不到一年后于 7 月离开了公司。

blocks.html_en: Bakalar joined OpenAI in August 2025 after spending about six years working on responsible AI at Meta. At OpenAI, she examined questions surrounding model behavior, human relationships with AI, and whether advanced systems could warrant moral consideration.

sentences.en: Bakalar joined OpenAI in August 2025 after spending about six years working on responsible AI at Meta.
sentences.zh: Bakalar 在 Meta 从事负责任的人工智能工作约六年后，于 2025 年 8 月加入 OpenAI。

sentences.en: At OpenAI, she examined questions surrounding model behavior, human relationships with AI, and whether advanced systems could warrant moral consideration.
sentences.zh: 在 OpenAI，她研究了围绕模型行为、人类与人工智能的关系以及先进系统是否值得道德考虑的问题。

blocks.html_en: Johannes Heidecke

sentences.en: Johannes Heidecke
sentences.zh: 约翰内斯·海德克

sentences.en: Johannes Heidecke (right).
sentences.zh: 约翰内斯·海德克（右）。

sentences.en: Sven Hoppe/picture alliance via Getty Images
sentences.zh: Sven Hoppe/图片联盟来自 Getty Images

blocks.html_en: Johannes Heidecke, who led OpenAI's safety systems team, left the company in July amid a reorganization of its safety operations.

sentences.en: Johannes Heidecke, who led OpenAI's safety systems team, left the company in July amid a reorganization of its safety operations.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 安全系统团队的领导者 Johannes Heidecke 在 7 月份因安全运营重组而离开了公司。

blocks.html_en: Heidecke joined OpenAI in 2021 and took charge of safety systems in 2024. His team evaluated models for potentially dangerous capabilities and developed safeguards intended to prevent harmful behavior.

sentences.en: Heidecke joined OpenAI in 2021 and took charge of safety systems in 2024.
sentences.zh: Heidecke 于 2021 年加入 OpenAI，并于 2024 年负责安全系统。

sentences.en: His team evaluated models for potentially dangerous capabilities and developed safeguards intended to prevent harmful behavior.
sentences.zh: 他的团队评估了潜在危险能力的模型，并制定了旨在防止有害行为的保障措施。

blocks.html_en: Following his departure, OpenAI placed its safety teams under Mia Glaese, its vice president of research and safety.

sentences.en: Following his departure, OpenAI placed its safety teams under Mia Glaese, its vice president of research and safety.
sentences.zh: 在他离职后，OpenAI 将其安全团队置于其研究和安全副总裁 Mia Glaese 的领导下。

blocks.html_en: Joshua Achiam

sentences.en: Joshua Achiam
sentences.zh: 约书亚·阿希姆

blocks.html_en: Joshua Achiam, OpenAI's chief futurist, left the company in July after nearly nine years.

sentences.en: Joshua Achiam, OpenAI's chief futurist, left the company in July after nearly nine years.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 首席未来学家 Joshua Achiam 在任职近 9 年后于 7 月离开公司。

blocks.html_en: Achiam previously led OpenAI's mission alignment team, which was tasked with helping the company uphold its founding goal of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits humanity. OpenAI disbanded that team in early 2026 and moved Achiam into the chief futurist role.

sentences.en: Achiam previously led OpenAI's mission alignment team, which was tasked with helping the company uphold its founding goal of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits humanity.
sentences.zh: Achiam 此前领导过 OpenAI 的使命调整团队，该团队的任务是帮助公司实现其创建目标，即确保通用人工智能造福人类。

sentences.en: OpenAI disbanded that team in early 2026 and moved Achiam into the chief futurist role.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 于 2026 年初解散了该团队，并将 Achiam 任命为首席未来学家。

blocks.html_en: Caitlin Kalinowski

sentences.en: Caitlin Kalinowski
sentences.zh: 凯特琳·卡利诺夫斯基

blocks.html_en: Caitlin Kalinowski, who led OpenAI's robotics and consumer hardware team, resigned in March over concerns about the company's agreement with the Pentagon.

sentences.en: Caitlin Kalinowski, who led OpenAI's robotics and consumer hardware team, resigned in March over concerns about the company's agreement with the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 机器人和消费硬件团队的负责人凯特琳·卡利诺夫斯基 (Caitlin Kalinowski) 因对该公司与五角大楼协议的担忧而于 3 月份辞职。

blocks.html_en: "Surveillance of Americans without judicial oversight and lethal autonomy without human authorization are lines that deserved more deliberation than they got," Kalinowski wrote on LinkedIn. She later said her objection was primarily about governance and that the agreement had been announced before its safeguards were fully defined.

sentences.en: "Surveillance of Americans without judicial oversight and lethal autonomy without human authorization are lines that deserved more deliberation than they got," Kalinowski wrote on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 卡利诺夫斯基在领英上写道：“在没有司法监督的情况下对美国人进行监视，在没有人类授权的情况下进行致命的自主权，这些都是值得深思熟虑的。”

sentences.en: She later said her objection was primarily about governance and that the agreement had been announced before its safeguards were fully defined.
sentences.zh: 她后来说，她的反对主要是关于治理，并且该协议是在其保障措施完全确定之前就宣布的。

blocks.html_en: Kalinowski joined OpenAI in November 2024 after leading Meta's augmented-reality hardware efforts, including its Orion glasses project. OpenAI said its Pentagon agreement prohibited domestic surveillance and the use of autonomous weapons.

sentences.en: Kalinowski joined OpenAI in November 2024 after leading Meta's augmented-reality hardware efforts, including its Orion glasses project.
sentences.zh: Kalinowski 于 2024 年 11 月加入 OpenAI，此前他领导了 Meta 的增强现实硬件工作，包括 Orion 眼镜项目。

sentences.en: OpenAI said its Pentagon agreement prohibited domestic surveillance and the use of autonomous weapons.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 表示，其五角大楼协议禁止国内监视和使用自主武器。

content_html_zh:
作者：Katherine Li 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 和 Lauren Edmonds 您目前正在关注这位作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

OpenAI 的旋转门仍在旋转。

这家 ChatGPT 制造商在 2026 年失去了一系列高级领导人，包括前运营首席布拉德·莱特卡普 (Brad Lightcap)、应用程序首席执行官 Fidji Simo、首席营收官丹尼斯·德莱瑟 (Denise Dresser) 以及负责营销、企业产品、科学、安全和道德的高管。 有些人离开去创办新企业，有些人则因为健康原因退出。

此次离职是在 2025 年又一年人员流动之后发生的，当时 OpenAI 失去了首席人力和通讯官、一名后来创办人工智能科学初创公司的顶级研究员，以及 Meta 招募的至少七名研究人员。

以下是即将在 2026 年退出的 OpenAI 杰出领导者。

丹尼斯·德莱瑟

OpenAI 在 8 月份宣布，其首席营收官 Denise Dresser 将离开公司。 德莱瑟于 2025 年 12 月开始担任该职位。

该公司在博客文章中写道：“丹尼斯将在过渡期后离开 OpenAI，寻求其他机会，在此期间，她将与业务团队密切合作，为我们的客户提供支持。”

达利·拉吉奇（Dali Rajic）将接任这一角色。

布拉德·莱特卡普

自 2018 年起在 OpenAI 工作的 Brad Lightcap 于 8 月在 X 上宣布离职。 Lightcap 告诉他的追随者，他将离开这家初创公司“去开始新的事情”。

“在过去的几个月里，我一直专注于下一步以及阻碍任务成功的因素。 我相信，当我们进入下一个时期时，世界需要解决一些重要的新问题，”Lightcap 在 X 上说道。 “我很快就会分享更多内容，但我比以往任何时候都更加相信 OpenAI，并且很高兴能够帮助大家从不同的角度推进任务。”

Lightcap 在 OpenAI 开始担任首席财务官，然后于 2022 年转任首席运营官。 今年 4 月，OpenAI 表示 Lightcap 已调任专注于特殊项目的职位。

菲吉·西莫

7 月，Fidji Simo 宣布她将辞去 OpenAI 应用程序首席执行官的职务，转而担任兼职顾问。 Simo 于 2019 年被诊断出患有姿势性心动过速综合征（POTS），最初于 4 月份请病假。

“在过去的七年里，我在医生的办公室里度过了无数的时间，处理症状、治疗、保险、不确定性，以及作为病人带来的所有无形的工作，”西莫在 7 月的 X 上写道。 “和数以百万计的慢性病患者一样，我亲身经历了医疗保健是多么困难，即使你拥有一切可能的优势。”

Simo 于 2025 年 5 月成为应用程序首席执行官。

凯文·威尔

凯文·韦尔 (Kevin Weil) 在 4 月的 X 上宣布离职。

“从首席产品官到加入研究团队并启动 OpenAI for Science，这两年是思想拓展的两年，”他说。

Weil 于 2024 年首次加入 OpenAI，担任首席产品官。 随后，他从 2025 年 10 月开始担任 OpenAI for Science 的副总裁，该计划旨在构建人工智能驱动的平台以加速科学发现。

目前，Weil 领导着一家人工智能科学初创公司，寻求至少 7.5 亿美元的估值。

比尔·皮布尔斯

Bill Peebles 在 OpenAI 担任了三年研究科学家，然后于 2026 年 4 月离开公司。 Peebles 担任 Sora 的负责人，Sora 是一种使用文本提示创建视频的人工智能模型。

Peeble 在 X 上表示：“虽然最初的 Sora 引发了整个行业对视频的巨额投资，但只有下一代型号的 Sora 2 才能让更广泛的公众了解正在发生的转变。” “我为这个团队在发布前后经历的所有不眠之夜感到自豪，以便以负责任的方式部署该技术并帮助引导社会规范。”

视频生成 AI 模型于 2024 年 12 月首次向用户提供。 九个月后，OpenAI 发布了更新的模型——Sora 2——以及一款旨在与社交媒体网站竞争的应用程序。

尽管该应用程序大肆宣传，但其势头很快就消退了。

OpenAI 今年四月关闭了 Sora 及其应用程序。

斯里尼瓦斯·纳拉亚南

OpenAI 商业应用首席技术官斯里尼瓦斯·纳拉亚南 (Srinivas Narayanan) 在 4 月份宣布，他在任职三年后将离职。

“领导 B2B 工程团队是一种巨大的荣幸，”纳拉亚南在 LinkedIn 上写道。 “随着最近/即将推出的产品，现在是退后一步的最佳时机。”

纳拉亚南说，他计划先去印度与父母共度时光，然后再决定下一步做什么。 他加入 OpenAI 担任工程副总裁，领导 ChatGPT 和公司企业产品的团队工作。

凯特·鲁什

Kate Rouch 于 4 月份辞去了 OpenAI 首席营销官的职务，专注于乳腺癌的康复。

Rouch 于 2024 年 12 月加入 OpenAI，此前她在 Meta 工作了十多年，担任全球品牌和产品营销主管。 2025年，她在接受治疗期间请了病假，然后回到了OpenAI。

OpenAI 此前表示，如果鲁什的健康状况允许，她最终可能会返回一个更狭窄的职位，并且该公司正在寻找新的首席营销官。

巴雷特·佐夫

Barret Zoph 于 6 月离开 OpenAI，大约五个月后，他返回领导其企业人工智能销售工作。

Zoph 最初于 2024 年 9 月离开 OpenAI，并与 OpenAI 前首席技术官 Mira Murati 共同创立了 Thinking Machines Lab。 在离开竞争对手初创公司 OpenAI 后，他于 2026 年 1 月重返 OpenAI。

OpenAI 没有透露 Zoph 离开的原因。

克洛伊·巴卡拉

OpenAI 道德主管 Chloé Bakalar 在加入公司不到一年后于 7 月离开了公司。

Bakalar 在 Meta 从事负责任的人工智能工作约六年后，于 2025 年 8 月加入 OpenAI。 在 OpenAI，她研究了围绕模型行为、人类与人工智能的关系以及先进系统是否值得道德考虑的问题。

约翰内斯·海德克

OpenAI 安全系统团队的领导者 Johannes Heidecke 在 7 月份因安全运营重组而离开了公司。

Heidecke 于 2021 年加入 OpenAI，并于 2024 年负责安全系统。 他的团队评估了潜在危险能力的模型，并制定了旨在防止有害行为的保障措施。

在他离职后，OpenAI 将其安全团队置于其研究和安全副总裁 Mia Glaese 的领导下。

约书亚·阿希姆

OpenAI 首席未来学家 Joshua Achiam 在任职近 9 年后于 7 月离开公司。

Achiam 此前领导过 OpenAI 的使命调整团队，该团队的任务是帮助公司实现其创建目标，即确保通用人工智能造福人类。 OpenAI 于 2026 年初解散了该团队，并将 Achiam 任命为首席未来学家。

凯特琳·卡利诺夫斯基

OpenAI 机器人和消费硬件团队的负责人凯特琳·卡利诺夫斯基 (Caitlin Kalinowski) 因对该公司与五角大楼协议的担忧而于 3 月份辞职。

卡利诺夫斯基在领英上写道：“在没有司法监督的情况下对美国人进行监视，在没有人类授权的情况下进行致命的自主权，这些都是值得深思熟虑的。” 她后来说，她的反对主要是关于治理，并且该协议是在其保障措施完全确定之前就宣布的。

Kalinowski 于 2024 年 11 月加入 OpenAI，此前他领导了 Meta 的增强现实硬件工作，包括 Orion 眼镜项目。 OpenAI 表示，其五角大楼协议禁止国内监视和使用自主武器。
